title: Use Seedance 2.0 Mini in CapCut when you need faster generation and lower…
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 Mini in CapCut when you need faster generation and lower credit cost than Seedance 2.0/2.0 Fast.  
Set output to Mini-720P (up to 720p) when generating with Seedance 2.0 Mini.  
Use Seedance 2.0 Mini when you want native audio and dialogue included in the generated video.
